body:
# VN Translation

Gói resource pack bổ sung ngôn ngữ `vi_vn` cho các mod chưa có bản dịch tiếng Việt.

**Mod được hỗ trợ**

- 3D Skin Layers
- Async Particles (async-particles, asyncparticles)
- Balm
- Better Biome Blend (better-biome-blend, betterbiomeblend, better-biome-blend_config)
- Better Enchants
- Better Hand Bobbing (better-hand-bobbing, betterhandbobbing)
- Bridging Mod (bridging-mod, bridgingmod)
- Cloth Config (cloth-config, cloth-config2)
- Combat Effects (combateffects)
- Continuity
- CreativeCore
- Cull Leaves (cullleaves)
- Debugify
- Dynamic FPS
- Dynamic Lights (dynamic-lights, dynamiclights)
- E4MC (e4mc, e4mc_minecraft)
- Enchantment Glint
- Entity Model Features (entity_model_features, entity-model-features)
- Entity Texture Features (entity_texture_features, entity-texture-features)
- Entity Culling (entityculling)
- Explosive Enhancement (explosive-enhancement, explosiveenhancement)
- Forge Config API Port (forgeconfigapiport)
- FPS Reducer (fps-reducer, fpsreducer)
- Freecam
- Freelook
- Fzzy Config (fzzy_config)
- Held Item Info (held-item-info)
- Inventory HUD (inventory-hud, inventoryhud)
- Inventory Sorter (inventory-sorter, inventorysorter)
- Inventory Profiles Next (inventoryprofiles)
- Invmove
- Iris Shaders (iris)
- Language Reload (languagereload)
- LibIPN
- Liteminer
- MaLiLib (malilib)
- MidnightLib
- Minecraft (bổ sung/điều chỉnh thuật ngữ gốc)
- ModernFix
- Mod Menu (modmenu)
- More Culling (moreculling)
- Nuit
- Particle Rain (particle-rain, particlerain)
- Particular
- Placeholder API (placeholder-api, placeholderapi)
- Polytone
- Presence Footsteps
- Respackopts
- Simple Block Overlay (simple-block-overlay, simpleblockoverlay)
- Smooth Particles (smooth-particles, smoothparticles)
- SmoothBoot
- Sodium
- Sodium Extra (sodium-extra, sodiumextra)
- Sound Physics Remastered (sound_physics_remastered)
- Sounds (sounds)
- Spawn Animations (spawn-animations, spawnanimations)
- Subtle Effects (subtle-effects, subtle_effects)
- Threadtweak
- Tweakeroo

- Xaero World Map (xaeroworldmap)

Nếu bạn phát hiện lỗi dịch hoặc muốn góp ý thuật ngữ, hãy mở issue hoặc gửi phản hồi để cập nhật nhanh nhất.
